blind_spots.reason: worker-run records the worker's own OUTCOME and never re-runs the verification its brief names
blind_spots.would_catch_if: worker-run re-ran the brief's verify command after the worker and recorded its exit

blind_spots.reason: nothing diffs the assertions a worker's changed test files hold against HEAD
blind_spots.would_catch_if: the run record counted removed or loosened assertions in the test files a run touched

blind_spots.what: the code revision a leg ran
blind_spots.reason: regression is judged by a leg's start time against the last fix; a leg started after a fix from a worktree or checkout without it reads regressed
blind_spots.would_catch_if: bench meta and worker-run meta recorded each repository's HEAD and a dirty digest at launch

blind_spots.reason: a cell that answers clean in a readable shape is a clean leg; whether it missed findings other raters and the judge confirmed is never joined back to it
blind_spots.would_catch_if: the judge's confirmed findings were joined per rater cell and a clean cell that missed one counted as a miss
